purpose: Canonical self-scoped Activity intention descriptor. B14-U2 extends the original B01 title/creation descriptor with optional description, location and per-item color override while preserving Activity identity and keeping temporal placement in Schedule.

columns.name: activity_ref
columns.meaning: Stable Activity NativeRef whose intention descriptor this row carries.
columns.value_contract: References one existing UUIDv7 Activity identity; this row does not mint or replace that identity.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated DANTE self Person whose personal Activity context owns this descriptor.
columns.value_contract: Existing Person NativeRef resolved through DanteContext; Person remains distinct from Account, Principal and Actor.

columns.name: title
columns.meaning: User-authored actionable-intention title for the Activity.

columns.name: description
columns.meaning: Optional canonical descriptive text captured with Activity authoring.
columns.value_contract: NULL or trimmed non-empty text; description is not Schedule, Context, Tag or Outcome state.

columns.name: location
columns.meaning: Optional canonical Activity location supplied by the author.
columns.value_contract: NULL or trimmed non-empty text; location is descriptive authoring metadata and does not become temporal placement.

columns.name: color_code
columns.meaning: Optional per-Activity presentation color override independent of Life Area color.
columns.value_contract: NULL or uppercase #RRGGBB. It does not create or imply a Life Area assignment.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Canonical creation instant recorded by the bounded CreateActivity capability.
columns.value_contract: Statement-time instant supplied inside the authoritative PostgreSQL create capability.

primary_key.name: pk_activity_intention
primary_key.reason: Exactly one current Activity intention descriptor is materialized per Activity identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_activity_intention_activity_ref_activity
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: The descriptor belongs to the existing Activity native owner rather than introducing a second Activity root.

foreign_keys.name: fk_activity_intention_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: The authoring descriptor is self-scoped while preserving Person as a separate native owner.

check_constraints.name: ck_activity_intention_title
check_constraints.reason: Reject empty, padded or unbounded Activity titles at the database boundary.

check_constraints.name: ck_activity_intention_description
check_constraints.expression_contract: description IS NULL OR (description=btrim(description) AND description<>'')
check_constraints.reason: Optional Activity description must be canonical trimmed non-empty text when present.

check_constraints.name: ck_activity_intention_location
check_constraints.expression_contract: location IS NULL OR (location=btrim(location) AND location<>'')
check_constraints.reason: Optional Activity location must be canonical trimmed non-empty text when present.

check_constraints.name: ck_activity_intention_color_code
check_constraints.reason: Optional per-item color is stored only as canonical uppercase #RRGGBB.

indexes.name: ix_activity_intention_self_person_created
indexes.reason: Deterministic self-scoped Activity ordering without using presentation state as canonical truth.

state_history.current_binding: The Activity descriptor is selected directly by Activity NativeRef; Schedule, Actual and Session remain separate families.
state_history.chronology: created_at records the authoritative creation instant; UUIDv7 ordering is never substituted for chronology.
state_history.immutability_policy: Runtime has no generic descriptor UPDATE authority. B14-U2 authoring may initialize description, location and color atomically during creation through a bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability; later editing requires its own governed mutation design.

lifecycle.retention: Retained with the canonical Activity while that Activity remains part of accepted DANTE product truth.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE. Destructive evolution requires a separately reviewed forward migration.

obligations: Activity identity remains the existing UUIDv7 NativeRef and is not duplicated by the descriptor
runtime can read but cannot directly INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE the descriptor
title, optional description/location and color integrity are enforced in PostgreSQL
Life Area assignment is optional and absence of an assignment row is valid
Activity location remains descriptive metadata and is not Schedule placement
